verses.text_en: And in those days Noah saw the earth that it had sunk down and its destruction was nigh.
verses.text_hr: U one je dane Noa vidio da je zemlja potonula i da se približilo njezino uništenje.

verses.text_en: And he arose from thence and went to the ends of the earth, and cried aloud to his grandfather Enoch: and Noah said three times with an embittered voice: ‘Hear me, hear me, hear me.’
verses.text_hr: Ustao je odande, otišao do krajeva zemlje i glasno povikao svojemu djedu Henoku. Noa je tri puta ogorčenim glasom rekao: „Čuj me, čuj me, čuj me!“

verses.text_en: And I said unto him: ‘Tell me what it is that is falling out on the earth that the earth is in such evil plight and shaken, lest perchance I shall perish with it.’
verses.text_hr: Rekao sam mu: „Kaži mi što se događa na zemlji da je u tako zlu stanju i da se trese, da možda ne propadnem zajedno s njom.“

verses.text_en: And thereupon there was a great commotion on the earth, and a voice was heard from heaven, and I fell on my face.
verses.text_hr: Tada je nastao silan potres na zemlji, začuo se glas s neba, a ja sam pao ničice.

verses.text_en: And Enoch my grandfather came and stood by me, and said unto me: ‘Why hast thou cried unto me with a bitter cry and weeping?
verses.text_hr: Moj djed Henok došao je, stao kraj mene i rekao: „Zašto si me zazvao gorkim krikom i plačem?

verses.text_en: And a command has gone forth from the presence of the Lord concerning those who dwell on the earth that their ruin is accomplished because they have learnt all the secrets of the angels, and all the violence of the Satans, and all their powers—the most secret ones—and all the power of those who practise sorcery, and the power of witchcraft, and the power of those who make molten images for the whole earth:
verses.text_hr: Iz nazočnosti Gospodnje izišla je zapovijed o stanovnicima zemlje da je njihova propast dovršena. Saznali su sve tajne anđela, sve nasilje sotona i sve njihove sile — one najskrivenije — zatim svu moć onih koji se bave vračanjem, moć čarobnjaštva i moć onih koji za svu zemlju izrađuju lijevane likove.

verses.text_en: And how silver is produced from the dust of the earth, and how soft metal originates in the earth.
verses.text_hr: Saznali su kako se srebro dobiva iz praha zemaljskoga i kako meka kovina nastaje u zemlji.

verses.text_en: For lead and tin are not produced from the earth like the first: it is a fountain that produces them, and an angel stands therein, and that angel is pre-eminent.’
verses.text_hr: Olovo i kositar ne nastaju iz zemlje poput onoga prvoga; proizvodi ih izvor u kojem stoji jedan anđeo, a taj je anđeo iznad ostalih.“

verses.text_en: And after that my grandfather Enoch took hold of me by my hand and raised me up, and said unto me: ‘Go, for I have asked the Lord of Spirits as touching this commotion on the earth.
verses.text_hr: Nakon toga moj me djed Henok uzeo za ruku, podigao i rekao: „Pođi, jer sam o tome potresu na zemlji pitao Gospodara duhova.

verses.text_en: And He said unto me: “Because of their unrighteousness their judgement has been determined upon and shall not be =withheld= by Me for ever. Because of the =sorceries= which they have searched out and learnt, the earth and those who dwell upon it shall be destroyed.”
verses.text_hr: Rekao mi je: ‘Zbog njihove nepravde njihov je sud određen i ja ga neću zauvijek =odgađati=. Zbog =čarolija= koje su istražili i naučili bit će uništeni zemlja i oni koji na njoj prebivaju.’

verses.text_en: And these—they have no =place of repentance= for ever, because they have shown them what was hidden, and they are the damned: but as for thee, my son, the Lord of Spirits knows that thou art pure, and guiltless of this reproach concerning the secrets.
verses.text_hr: Oni zauvijek nemaju =mjesta za pokajanje= jer su ljudima pokazali ono što je bilo skriveno; oni su prokleti. Ali za tebe, sine moj, Gospodar duhova zna da si čist i nedužan za ovaj prijekor zbog tajni.

verses.text_en:
And He has destined thy name to be among the holy,
And will preserve thee amongst those who dwell on the earth,
And has destined thy righteous seed both for kingship and for great honours,
And from thy seed shall proceed a fountain of the righteous and holy without number for ever.’
verses.text_hr:
Odredio je da tvoje ime bude među svetima,
sačuvat će te među stanovnicima zemlje
i odredio je tvojemu pravednom potomstvu kraljevstvo i velike časti.
Iz tvojega će potomstva poteći nebrojen izvor pravednih i svetih zauvijek.“
